subject: OrbitVC Fall '26 cohort — self-serve credit approval & issuance
messages:
From: Sarah Liao <sarah@orbitvc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T16:10:00Z
Subject: Request: cohort credits for OrbitVC Fall '26

Hi Marissa —

Hope you're well. OrbitVC is running our Fall 2026 cohort and we'd like to request a one-time credits allocation for the cohort sandbox (about 25 companies). Typical ask is 50k credits to help founders prototype on Redwood quickly during demo prep.

Attached: roster (names + company), cohort attestation signed by our program director. We can provide company sites and incorporation docs on request.

Can you confirm the eligibility path and estimated turnaround? Ideally the founders should be able to self-redeem via a portal link.

Thanks —
Sarah
Director, Programs
OrbitVC Accelerator
(sarah@orbitvc.com)

Attachments: orbit_fall26_roster.pdf, orbit_cohort_attestation.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah@orbitvc.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credits for OrbitVC Fall '26

Thanks for the details, Sarah — this looks straightforward. Quick notes and next steps: 

- OrbitVC cohorts are eligible under our accelerator program rule-set (50k one-time credits for cohorts under 40 companies) but we need a brief attestation and roster (you already attached both — perfect).
- I'll loop Aditya from Growth Ops to handle issuance and provide the self-serve link.
- Looping Soojin for a quick compliance check (SOC2/data retention) — she'll confirm there's no blocker for the cohort sandbox.

Aditya — can you provision a 50k cohort credit package and share the self-serve redemption link and redemption TTL? Also please attach the issuance_manifest when ready so Sarah can distribute to founders.

Sarah — one practical ask: do you want a single redemption code for the cohort or unique codes per startup? We typically recommend unique codes for auditability but can do either.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Liao <sarah@orbitvc.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credits for OrbitVC Fall '26

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 09:23 Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Aditya — can you provision a 50k cohort credit package and share the self-serve redemption link and redemption TTL? Also please attach the issuance_manifest when ready so Sarah can distribute to founders.

Thanks Marissa — I've reviewed the roster and attestation. Soojin confirmed there are no outstanding compliance flags for this cohort (see her note below).

Action I took: provisioned a 50,000-credit allocation under account tag ORBIT-FALL26 and generated unique redemption codes per company.

What I'm sending: 
- Self-serve issuance link (one-click for admin distribution): https://app.redwood.com/self-serve/credits/issue?token=xx-ORB-2026
- Issuance manifest (CSV) with one code per company and expiry (30 days): issuance_manifest.csv (attached).
- Admin guide excerpt (how founders redeem in the console): redeem_instructions.txt (inline below).

Important details: 
- TTL: codes expire 30 days after issuance.
- Per-company cap: 2,000 credits max per company by default (we can increase per-request).
- Audit: all redemptions will be logged to the OrbitVC ledger in Console > Billing > Credits.

Attached: issuance_manifest.csv

Marissa/Sarah — let me know if you want a single master code instead of per-company codes. If so, I can re-issue immediately.

—Aditya
Growth Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Liao <sarah@orbitvc.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credits for OrbitVC Fall '26

On Tue, Nov 16, 2026 at 14:02 Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — I've reviewed the roster and attestation. Soojin confirmed there are no outstanding compliance flags for this cohort (see her note below).

Confirming: no compliance blockers for issuing cohort credits. The attestation includes the program director signature and a roster with company domiciles. A couple small notes for the audit record:
- Please retain the signed attestation in the OrbitVC folder (Drive link recommended).
- Use unique codes when possible — it makes entitlement tracking and potential chargebacks simpler.

Agree with Aditya's defaults (30-day TTL, per-company cap).

Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Sarah Liao <sarah@orbitvc.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T21:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credits for OrbitVC Fall '26

Thanks everyone — received the issuance_manifest.csv and the self-serve link. We'll distribute the unique codes to founders this week and confirm redemptions. Appreciated the quick turnaround and the per-company codes — that's exactly what we needed.

One founder asked about a short extension window if they can't redeem before TTL; is that something we can support per-request? If so, what's the process?

Thanks again —
Sarah
Director, Programs
OrbitVC Accelerator
